work_handoff.title: N21｜Cohort Enters — Inside the Flow｜Candidate 09｜Clean Regeneration
requirements: Candidate 09 is NOT authorized by this validation-only spec. If later separately authorized, generate exactly one 941×1672 PNG and stop for Product Owner review.
Generation mode = CLEAN REGENERATION. Candidate 01–08 are diagnostic/historical evidence only and must not be used as edit bases or direct visual inputs.
Highest shot authorities = N21 Node-Level Director Shot Design V0.2 + Review Patch 01 + Bundle V007 written handoff.
Camera = INSIDE CASTLE / JUST BEYOND THRESHOLD / SHOULDER HEIGHT / OFF-AXIS / LOOKING DIAGONALLY INWARD.
Camera relation = AMONG / BESIDE THE MOVING PEOPLE, not standing back to photograph the group.
Participant flow = LEFT-REAR THRESHOLD → RIGHT-FORWARD DEEPER INTERIOR.
Extreme screen-left retains only a partial cue of the same physical right-side carved door leaf. Door remains open and subordinate.
N21_CASTLE_ENTRANCE_DOOR_IDENTITY_REFERENCE_V001 controls door identity, carving, wood material, visible edge, open state and narrow opening cue only.
DO NOT inherit the Door Identity reference camera, framing, crop, screen placement, complete doorway geometry, exterior composition, floor, crowd blocking, crowd direction or lighting.
Door camera/composition inheritance = FORBIDDEN.
Use approximately 4–6 visible figures or body fragments; only 3–4 need coherent readable full or near-full body silhouettes.
Use anonymous identities selected from Generic Guest A–J. Do not force all ten and do not visually prove the full sixteen-person cohort.
Generic Guest REAR_3Q controls anonymous Guest identity, body-build, hairstyle, garment silhouette, footwear and rear/side-back continuity only.
Do NOT copy the Generic Guest 2×5 board layout, all-ten count, left/right order, equal spacing, exact poses or original board-facing orientation.
Generic Guest FRONT is not delivered directly but remains global identity conflict authority: FRONT WINS.
Crowd must be naturally staggered: unequal lateral positions, unequal depth, unequal gaps, asynchronous gait and natural overlap.
No visible leader, single-file queue, V formation, front-two/middle-two/rear-one formation, equal spacing or synchronized walking.
N21 is GROUP FIRST / NO NAMED-CHARACTER PRESENTATION TASK. Neil must not appear. Ning Qiushui, Jun Luyuan, Su Xiaoxiao, Liao Jian, Wen Qingya and Guang Yong need not be readable.

Environment is same castle / same continuous period as N20/N22/N23 but controlled in text only: warm low-key interior, dark aged wood/stone, restrained practical warm light, deeper interior gradually darker and partially concealed.
Architecture = PARTIAL SPATIAL PRESSURE / NOT SUBJECT. Do not show complete First Hall, complete grand arch, long clean corridor, repeated arches, monumental symmetry or centered architectural axis.
Exterior daylight = NARROW EDGE CUE ONLY. No large blue-sky field, white portal, hard daylight beam or broad cool floor reflection.
Threat/unknown feeling remains secondary and latent. No fantasy fog, supernatural glow or blue horror reset.
No backpack, shoulder bag, crossbody bag, handbag, luggage, travel bag or visible large bag strap.
Before any later generation, Work must revalidate Bundle V007 2/2 exact match. Any SHA / byte / Git blob / manifest mismatch means STOP / DO NOT GENERATE.
exclusions: Generic Guest FRONT as direct visual input
all ten Generic Guests forced into frame
